The verification loop used stale song-review data, so I need to re-fetch all song reviews for the 12 target IDs after the updates and then inspect their actual ratings.

```python
current_ratings = {}
for song_id in target_song_ids:
    reviews = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=song_id)
    current_ratings[song_id] = max(review.get('rating', 0) for review in reviews)
print(current_ratings)
```
